visualCharacteristics.columns: 2 (3 when the block has exactly 3 cards)

contentPattern: 1 row per card, 1 cell: topic question (h3), statement (a second h3, or a fully bold paragraph), explanatory paragraph(s), and an optional last paragraph holding only a link (rendered as an underlined text link pinned to the bottom of the card). Dividers between the three parts are drawn by CSS. With a single heading and no bold paragraph, that heading is the statement. Layout: 1 column on mobile; from 900px 2 per row, or 3 across when the block has exactly 3 cards (automatic, no option). Section intro (h2, text) is default content above the block.
